name: Keuka Brewing Company
hoursNote: Closed Tuesday; hours vary seasonally—check website before visiting.
description: The first craft brewery on Keuka Lake, founded in 2008 by the Musso family. Multi-award-winning small-batch ales and lagers—including Best Craft Brewery in NY State at TAP NY 2014—served in a relaxed tasting room with patio seating.

name: Abandon Brewing Company
address: 2994 Merritt Hill Road, Penn Yan, NY 14527
hoursNote: Closed Tuesday; hours vary seasonally—confirm at abandonbrewing.com.
description: Craft brewery set in a restored barn on the northwest shore of Keuka Lake near Branchport, featuring rotating small-batch ales, sours, and IPAs with stunning lake views. Outdoor beer garden with regular food truck and live music events.

name: Finger Lakes Beer Company
hoursNote: Hours may vary seasonally; confirm at fingerlakesbeercompany.com.
description: NYS Farm Brewery just outside Hammondsport near the south end of Keuka Lake, crafting award-winning ales and lagers with local ingredients. Features an outdoor deck, cornhole, horseshoe pit, and seasonal food trucks and live music.

name: Treetops Cidery
address: 8842 E Bluff Dr, Penn Yan, NY 14527
hoursNote: Open Thursday–Sunday only; seasonal—call ahead or check Instagram @treetops_cidery.
description: Family-owned farmhouse cidery on the east bluff of Keuka Lake, producing small-batch all-natural hard ciders from locally sourced Finger Lakes apples. Aviation-inspired tasting room with rotating seasonal and core varieties; no added sugars.

name: Apple Barrel Orchards
address: 2673 Sand Hill Rd, Penn Yan, NY 14527
hoursNote: Open Friday–Sunday only; seasonal—verify at applebarrelorchards.com.
description: Fourth-generation family farm and cidery near Keuka Lake offering 9+ hand-crafted hard ciders on tap in a historic 1896 barn tasting room, made from estate-grown apples with no additives or sulfites. Multi-medal winner at the U.S. Open Cider Championship.

name: Lake Life Brewery
hoursNote: Opened October 2024; verify current hours at lakelifebreweryny.com.
description: Downtown Penn Yan brewery opened October 2024, specializing in European-style ales (German Weiss, Czech Pilsner) and wood-fired pizza. Regular live music and trivia nights in a community-focused taproom steps from Keuka Lake.

name: Krookid Leyk Distilling
hoursNote: Closed Wednesday; hours may vary seasonally—verify at krookidleyk.com.
description: Craft distillery on Route 54 along Keuka Lake, producing handcrafted small-batch Finger Lakes spirits. Intimate tasting room offering flights and cocktails made from locally sourced grain.

name: Birds Eye Hollow Farm and Distillery
hoursNote: Hours sourced from third-party listing; verify directly with the distillery before visiting.
description: Maple syrup farm turned craft distillery outside Hammondsport, producing small-batch spirits infused with estate-made maple syrup. Welcoming log-cabin tasting room with live music events, approximately 5 miles from the south end of Keuka Lake.
